title: Indefeasible
summary: INDEFE'ASIBLE, adjective s as z. [in and defeasible; facio.] Not to be defeated; that cannot be made void; as an indefeasible estate or title.

inlines.v: INDEFE'ASIBLE, adjective s as z. [in and defeasible; facio.] Not to be defeated; that cannot be made void; as an indefeasible estate or title.
